Biology 2010-I.question: Which one of the following plants is popularly grown along the road for absorbing vehicular pollutants?

Biology 2010-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2010-I.question: A milkman puts banana leaf in milk jar, because banana leaf
options: gives a fresh flavour to milk
makes the milk acidic and resistant to yeast
makes the milk basic and resistant to yeast
Biology 2010-I.answer: makes the milk basic and resistant to yeast
Biology 2010-I.explanation: (c)  A milkman puts banana leaf in milkpot because leaf can make the milk basic and avoid yeast formation (fermentation). Banana leaf has tryptophan which creates basicity.

Biology 2010-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2010-I.question: Which one of the following is not biodegradable?
Biology 2010-I.explanation: (b)  Silver foil is manufactured from metal that is non biodegrable. Woollen mat, leather bag and jute basket are biodegradable because they are manufactured from natural materials.

Biology 2010-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2010-I.question: Tips of leaves in grasses and common garden plants show water drops in early morning hours. This water accumulation is obtained from
Biology 2010-I.explanation: (b)  Tips of leaves in grasses and common garden plants exhibit water droplets in early morning hours because of a atmospheric phenomenon of dew formation. Dew is produced due to condensation of atmospheric moisture.

Biology 2010-I.question: Itching due to insect bite is caused by

Biology 2010-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2010-I.question: Which one among the following is a major source of sugar?
Biology 2010-I.explanation: (c)  Sugarcane is a main raw material  for the production of sugar. Sugar producing countries are Cuba, Brazil, India and China.

Biology 2010-I.explanation: (b)  Vitamin-B is water soluble. Its over-dose is excreted out in urine, vitamin A, D, E and K are fat soluble therefore, they are not excreted in urine.

Biology 2010-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2010-I.question: Which one among the following plants cannot be multiplied by cuttings?
Biology 2010-I.explanation: (c)  The banana develops from stem. The aerial parts of banana exhibit only leaves. Therefore, banana can’t be multiplied by cuttings.

Biology 2010-I.question: Which one of the following plants is used for green manuring in India?
Biology 2010-I.explanation: (b)  Sunnhemp (crotoloria juncea) is a plant which is utilized for green manuring in India. It is largely cultivated for green manure and its leaves are fed as high protion supplement to other poorer feeds.
